note: Every listed enchant has no level requirement, so a level-19 can carry it.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Fiery Weapon
enchants.notes: The iconic melee twink weapon enchant; no level requirement lets a 19 carry a proc far above the bracket.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Crusader
enchants.effect: Chance on hit: +100 Strength for 15s and a small heal.
enchants.notes: Big burst window on proc; healers also run it on a caster weapon for the heal.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Icy Chill
enchants.effect: Chance on hit: frost damage and a movement/attack-speed slow.
enchants.notes: Control option for melee; the slow is valuable for kiting and flag-carrier pressure.

enchants.name: Enchant Boots - Minor Speed
enchants.notes: Movement speed is highly valued in WSG, especially for flag carriers; a near-universal boots pick.

enchants.name: Lesser Arcanum of Constitution
enchants.notes: Dire Maul libram head/leg arcanum with no level requirement; the defensive head/leg enchant for survivability builds.

enchants.name: Lesser Arcanum of Voracity
enchants.notes: Offensive head/leg arcanum with no level requirement; the agility head/leg enchant for damage builds.

enchants.name: Might of the Scourge
enchants.effect: +26 Attack Power and +1% critical strike chance.
enchants.notes: The melee/physical shoulder pick and the centerpiece of most 19 melee sets. Dropped by Sapphiron in Naxxramas (item 23548); the inscription does not soulbind the shoulder, so a level-60 applies it to a BoE Requires Level 19 white shoulder and mails the piece to the twink.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Greater Resistance
enchants.notes: All-resistance cloak enchant; a balanced defensive back pick.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Greater Nature Resistance
enchants.notes: Nature-resistance cloak enchant; situational against nature-heavy matchups (e.g. shaman, druid, hunter).

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Major Health
enchants.notes: Flat health chest enchant for survivability builds.

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Greater Stats
enchants.notes: All-stats chest enchant for balanced/offensive builds.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Superior Stamina
enchants.notes: Stamina bracer enchant for survivability builds.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Superior Strength
enchants.notes: Strength bracer enchant for melee damage builds.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Superior Agility
enchants.notes: Agility gloves enchant; a strong pick for physical damage classes.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Lifestealing
enchants.effect: Chance on hit: deal Shadow damage and heal the attacker for the amount dealt.
enchants.notes: Sustain weapon enchant with no level requirement; favored on midfield/duelist builds for self-healing.

enchants.name: Accurate Scope
enchants.effect: +3 weapon damage (applies to a bow, crossbow, or gun).
enchants.notes: Engineering ranged-weapon scope with no level requirement; flat damage on a bow/crossbow/gun.

enchants.name: Fortitude of the Scourge
enchants.notes: Defensive Scourge shoulder enchant; the survivability counterpart to Might of the Scourge. Dropped by Sapphiron in Naxxramas (item 23549); does not soulbind the shoulder, so it's applied to a BoE Requires Level 19 white shoulder and mailed to the twink.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Lesser Shadow Resistance
enchants.notes: Shadow-resistance cloak enchant; situational against warlocks, shadow priests, and rogue poisons.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Greater Strength
enchants.notes: Strength gloves enchant for melee damage builds; an alternative to Superior Agility on strength-scaling classes.

enchants.name: Enchant Shield - Greater Stamina
enchants.notes: Stamina shield enchant for shield-using builds.

enchants.name: Enchant Shield - Frost Resistance
enchants.notes: Frost-resistance shield enchant; situational against mages and frost effects.

enchants.name: Thorium Shield Spike
enchants.effect: Chance on block to deal Physical damage to the attacker.
enchants.notes: Blacksmithing shield spike with no level requirement; retaliation damage on block for shield builds.

enchants.name: Steel Weapon Chain
enchants.notes: Blacksmithing weapon chain with no level requirement; prevents disarm on a melee weapon.

enchants.name: Enchant 2H Weapon - Agility
enchants.notes: Two-hand agility enchant with no level requirement; the agility stat stick for 2H weapons.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Agility
enchants.notes: One-hand agility weapon enchant with no level requirement; an agility stat stick for 1H weapons.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Greater Intellect
enchants.notes: Intellect bracer enchant; used on hybrid/caster-leaning builds for a larger mana pool.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Mighty Intellect
enchants.notes: Intellect weapon enchant with no level requirement; a caster stat-stick option on staves.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Mighty Spirit
enchants.notes: Spirit weapon enchant with no level requirement; a regen-focused stat-stick option on staves.

enchants.name: Lesser Arcanum of Rumination
enchants.notes: Dire Maul libram head/leg arcanum with no level requirement; the mana head/leg enchant for caster-hybrid damage builds.

enchants.name: Resilience of the Scourge
enchants.notes: Healing-oriented Scourge shoulder enchant; the restoration counterpart to Might/Fortitude of the Scourge. Dropped by Sapphiron in Naxxramas (item 23547); does not soulbind the shoulder, so it's applied to a BoE Requires Level 19 white shoulder and mailed to the twink.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Healing Power
enchants.notes: Healing-power gloves enchant for restoration/support hybrid builds.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Healing Power
enchants.notes: Healing-power weapon enchant with no level requirement; a restoration stat-stick option on a one-hand caster weapon.

enchants.name: Enchant Shield - Superior Spirit
enchants.notes: Spirit shield enchant for regen-leaning shield-using caster-hybrid builds.

enchants.name: Power of the Scourge
enchants.effect: +15 Spell Damage and Healing and +1% spell critical strike.
enchants.notes: Caster-damage Scourge shoulder enchant; the spellpower counterpart to Might/Fortitude of the Scourge. Dropped by Sapphiron in Naxxramas (item 23545); does not soulbind the shoulder, so it's applied to a BoE Requires Level 19 white shoulder and mailed to the twink.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Frost Power
enchants.notes: Frost-damage gloves enchant for frost-spec casters.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Spell Power
enchants.notes: Spellpower weapon enchant used on caster one-hand weapons; no level requirement.

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Major Mana
enchants.notes: Mana chest enchant with no level requirement; the caster-DPS counterpart to Major Health for mana-pool builds.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Healing Power
enchants.notes: Healing-power bracer enchant for restoration/support hybrid builds.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Shadow Power
enchants.notes: Shadow-damage gloves enchant for shadow-spec casters.
